auth.description: How it authenticates, one the provider and its preset offer.

auto_qualify.description: Queue newly listed models for the agents' evals (AI-81); off by default. Adding a model to the allow-list stays a person's decision.

configuration.description: Its configuration, as the provider's manifest describes it.

connector.description: The model provider's connector, from listConnectorCatalogue.

credential.description: The provider's API key, for an api-key connection: stored at once, never shown again, and the connection's when the request is approved (AI-79). A consumer plan's token, a session or a cookie is refused (AI-73).

data_handling.description: Its data-handling declaration (AI-75, AI-88); switching it on needs one, with its data inventory row and, when it processes outside Singapore, its transfer assessment.

preset.description: One of the provider's presets, from listConnectorCatalogue.
